title: Rush Retention on Deposit Credits of Cancelled Network and Server Orders
content:
The expedite retention of a deposit credit, the Hardware Procurement deposit credit that returns the paid deposit of a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, applies only to an order quoted with rush: the order type's rush fee when the purchase order is at least one day old on the credit day, half of it when the purchase order was placed that same day, and nothing for an order quoted without rush. It is retained from the deposit credit.

| Quoted with rush | Purchase order on the credit day | Network Equipment Order | Server & Storage Build Order |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | at least one day old | 150.00 | 350.00 |
| Yes | placed that same day | 75.00 | 175.00 |
| No | any | nothing | nothing |

The rush flag and the purchase order date are read from the order's own record; the rush fee is the order type's figure in the service charge schedule.
